BRTIMDTC in SDTM is assigned from raw data which is derived using the below preprocessed method.
Complete date values are imputed in the raw database based on partial dates collected in DM.BRTHDTC. The imputed birth date will use 01Jul for the unknown birth day and month since only year is collected on the CRF in DM.BRTHDTC. If month and year are collected, as in a pediatric study, then 15 will be used for the day in the imputed date of birth. If raw.BRTHDTC contains complete date in pediatric studies then BRTIMDTC is also populated with the same complete date value by CP.
Set DTHFL to 'Y', if date of death is not missing.
If lbnam="GILEAD" then assign LBDRVFL to "Y".
If the deviation is important, then assign as 'MAJOR', else if the deviation is not important, then assign as 'MINOR'.
Sequential number identifying a unique record within each USUBJID. It is generated by using the sort order defined in the keys column of the define file.

If the date is on or after RFSTDTC, then the study day is the number of days between the date and RFSTDTC inclusive. If the date is prior to RFSTDTC, then the study day is the number of (negative) days between the date and RFSTDTC excluding RFSTDTC.

USUBJID in SDTM is assigned from raw data which is derived using the below preprocessed method.
Concatenate study ID, Inv ID, and subject ID (Separated by '-')
Inv ID: For randomized/enrolled subjects: - Inv ID at the time of randomization/enrollment is used. - If the subject changes sites during the study, Inv ID will be populated with the earliest Inv number at the time of randomization/enrollment. For screen failures: - The Inv ID from the earliest screening will be used.
Subject ID: For randomized/enrolled subjects: - Subject ID is obtained when subject is randomized/enrolled. If Subject ID is 4 characters, precede the value with a zero. For screen failures: - Use Screening ID -A subject may rescreen multiple times. These subjects may eventually be randomized/enrolled in which case they will obtain a subject ID. - For rescreened subjects who remains as screen failure, the screening ID from the earliest screening record is used.

For scheduled visits, VISITNUM are assigned with their corresponding VISITNUM in SDTM.TV. For unscheduled visits, VISITNUM are derived by adding 0.01 for each additional date to the VISITNUM of the previous record in the chronical order.
